description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ClaimRequestAPIHelperTrait' within the namespace OrangeHRM\Claim\Api\Traits. The trait includes helper methods for handling claim requests, such as verifying if an action is permitted on a claim request and retrieving claim request data, leveraging other traits and services related to user roles and claim management.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed on a given claim request based on user roles and workflow state.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest object by request ID, ensuring it exists and that the requesting user has access rights.
